name: Demolition Day
design_intent:
PHYSICS-LAB circuit 4, course 2 of 4 (owner 2026-07-16: 'physics puzzles solved by knocking over or exploding things'). DESTROY_ALL: wreck every crate on the site — 10 destructible_blocks in three sub-puzzles, each teaching a different way to break things. Verified against DestructibleBlock.gd: break_on 'hit' = any bounce contact >= 300px/s costs 1hp; break_on 'smash' = a fired super (is_super_active) OR contact speed >= Tuning.smash_impact_min (900px/s) costs 1hp — and plain boost caps at 760px/s (INV-1), so SMASH crates are IMMUNE to normal flying: only a super or a genuine dive breaks them. Dive math: impact speed = sqrt(2*1600*fall) -> a 253px free fall hits exactly 900px/s; every smash dive in this course has 300px+ of drop.

THE THREE PUZZLES:
(A) THE TOWER (right, floating over the void): three SMASH hp1 crates stacked at x1900, y700/810/920 (column y700-1020 with 10px seams). Two solutions, both taught: (1) CHAIN DIVE — climb above the tower (boost; top crate is 380px above the base pad top, > trampoline 270), free-fall 300px+ onto the top crate (>=980px/s = smash), the trampoline-tier crate BOUNCES you back up (apex 270) while it cracks and breaks 0.28s later, and the re-fall from that bounce apex hits the next crate at ~930px/s — the tower eats itself one dive rhythm at a time; (2) SUPER — one vertical super (2800px/s, super_active 0.45s = 1260px of licensed travel) hammered up or down the 320px column registers a hit on each crate's own detector (per-block 0.3s hit_cd is independent). Recovery is over the void: the crate bounce itself refunds nothing but the base/spring pads are one boost away.
(B) THE SEALED BOX (left): four HIT hp1 shell faces (top 140,560 480x80; bottom 140,1000 480x80; left wall 60,640 80x360; right wall 620,640 80x360 — flush against the base pad edge at x700) enclose a CORE crate (310,760 140x100, SMASH hp1). The core's damage sensor (rect + 12px) is unreachable while the shell stands: the ONLY order is break a face first (any >=300px/s bounce — a 760px/s boost ram works, and the face bounces you off as it cracks), fly in through the 480px opening, then SUPER the core — inside the 480x360 chamber there is no 253px of fall, so the super (min 5 fuel) is the only smash tool in there. This is the 'break things to forge the path to more things' beat.
(C) THE HIGH SHELF: two HIT hp1 crates at y260 (x700 and x1500, 200x90). They hang 820px above the pads — beyond even the SPRING apex (480), so the only way up is spring bounce + sustained boost (boost_gravity_scale 0.8 while thrusting). Pure flight gate.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight required):
- High shelf crates: 820px above footing > spring 480 -> BOOST mandatory (course cannot complete without it — DESTROY_ALL counts them).
- Tower: top crate 380px above base pad top > trampoline 270 -> BOOST to set up the dive; recovery from the over-void bounce-offs is boost or die (free respawn).
- Core: SUPER mandatory (>=5 fuel) — plain boost 760 < 900 gate, no fall room inside.
- Base pad (700,1080 w520 trampoline) and spring pad (1350,1080 w300 spring) are the only permanent footing; both bounce (no standable ground).
Every sub-puzzle demands a flight verb: boost climb, dive (a controlled flight exit), or super.

FUEL BUDGET: spawn 100. Shelf run: spring bounce is free, ~1.4s boost (~40) to top out at y260, crates bounce you back (they are trampoline-tier surfaces). Box run: one boost ram (~10) + entry + one super (dumps tank, min 5 to fire); the shell faces are bounce surfaces so working inside the box refunds +20 per touch before the super. Tower run: climb ~30, dives are free, each crate bounce sustains the rhythm. Order is free (any-order clear); the natural route is shelf while fuel is full -> tower -> box last (the super dump ends near the pads for refuel). A fall = free respawn with a full tank, blocks stay broken (DESTROY_ALL state persists in-run).

FAIRNESS: every crate telegraphs 0.28s of cracks before vanishing; no crate is anyone's sole footing (base + spring pads always remain — no softlock); void spans the whole floor; spawn (960,980) is over the base pad, clear of all crates. Explicit bounds give 1400px of climb headroom over the high shelf.
hint: DIVE OR SUPER — SMASH EVERY CRATE
